blocks.order: row-major from the north-west block; each row's block_medians follows this order
blocks.rule: a block's median counts when at least half of its in-area pixels are clear

cache._means: a repeat of this exact request inside ttl_s returns this same signed series; a scene acquired since computed_at appears after it expires

cautions: no same-season anomaly: no earlier-year scene within 30 days of the latest one's day of year was clear enough (scene cloud under 80% and the area's clear floor). That season is cloudy here; the latest value has no like-for-like baseline.
the change map compares scenes 60 days of year apart: part of every block's change is the season.

estimand.clear_fraction_means: share of the area's pixels with an unmasked, in-swath reading of every band the index uses
estimand.known_bias: the scene classification misses haze and thin cloud edges; what it misses lowers the index, so `partial` scenes can read low
estimand.quantity: NDVI of the area, per Sentinel-2 overpass
estimand.statistic: per scene: median and nearest-rank p10/p25/p75/p90 over clear pixels, plus mean and sample std
estimand.support: 10 m Sentinel-2 L2A pixels whose centre lies inside the area (57798 pixels)

fields.rule: each field's pixels are the window pixels whose centre lies inside it (and inner_buffer_m inside its edge); a field's scene counts when it meets min_clear_fraction and min_support_px on its own pixels, whatever the window's clear share
fields.scene_check: a row is suspect when the field's value sits on the same side of both neighbouring scenes by at least 0.2 from each (neighbours at most 30 days apart), or on a `suspect_dates` date, where at least 25% of the fields read that day failed that check. Suspect rows are left out of each field's trend.

reproducibility: every scene id, asset and mask is pinned in the signed record (resolve the token for it); re-reading those scenes with the stated formula, mask, quantile rule and selection gives the same rows

selection.rule: one scene per capture date (least scene cloud), then up to max_scenes evenly spaced in time keeping both ends, plus for the newest the least cloudy scene within 30 days of its day of year in each of up to three earlier years

trend.method: Theil-Sen slope of the per-scene median; Kendall S with the no-ties normal approximation, two-sided, its variance corrected for autocorrelation (Hamed and Rao 1998); scenes marked suspect are left out
trend.p_value_withheld: the scenes kept span 0.84 years and 20% of that is a partial year, so the season tilts the line; a window whose clear scenes span whole years gives a p-value
